messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Edit and output the float value
messages.description: Clicking and dragging up and down on the number box with the mouse (when the patcher window is locked) moves the displayed value up and down, and outputs the new values continuously.In the float number box, dragging to the left of the decimal point changes the value in increments of 1. Dragging to the right of the decimal point changes the fractional part of the number in increments of 0.01.When the active patcher window is locked, numbers can be entered into a number box by clicking on it with the mouse and typing in a number on the computer keyboard. Typing the Return or Enter keys on Macintosh or the Enter key on Windows, or clicking outside the number box, sends the number out the outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the currently displayed number out the outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed in theand sent out the outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Convert, store, display and output value
messages.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed in theand sent out the outlet.

messages.name: max
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the maximum value that can be displayed or sent out by the. The wordby itself sets the maximum to None (removes a prior maximum value constraint).

messages.name: min
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the minimum value that can be displayed or sent out by the. The wordby itself sets the minimum to None (removes a prior minimum value constraint).

messages.name: select
messages.description: The wordwill make the number box active so that you can type numbers straight into it (click on any empty space in a locked patcher to deselect it).

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Store and display value with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the stored and displayed value to that number without triggering output.
